name: Basilisk: Kouga Ninpou Chou
original_title: バジリスク甲賀忍法帖
description: The story takes place in the year 1614. Two ninja clans, Tsubagakure of the Iga and Manjidani of Kouga, battle each other to determine which grandson of Tokugawa Ieyasu will become the next shogun. The deadly competition between 10 elite ninja from each clan unleashes a centuries-old hatred that threatens to destroy all hope for peace between them.

episodes.name: Kader
episodes.description: Lord Ieyasu, her seçkin ninjanın kendi yeteneklerini göstermek için Iga ve Kouga ninja klanının liderleri olan Ogen ve Danjo'yu çağırıyor. Etkilenen Ieyasu, bir sonraki Shogun'u belirlemek için klanlara karşı savaş ilan eder.

episodes.name: son randevu
episodes.description: Hem Ogen hem de Danjo'nun ölümünden sonra, öldüklerini bilmeden Gennosuke ve Oboro, birleşip klanlara bezelye getirebilecek düğünlerini planlıyorlar. Ancak, Iga klanı bir parşömen aldıktan sonra Kouga klanına karşı savaşı dört gözle bekliyor.

episodes.name: Savaş Saldırısı
episodes.description: Iga klanı, ikinci parşömene sahip olan Kazamachi'yi avlamak ve öldürmek için yola çıkar. Tenzen liderliğinde, Iga klanının bazı üyeleri savaşın başladığına dair hiçbir haberin Kouga'ya yayılmamasını sağlamayı planlıyor.

episodes.name: Boynuzlu Baykuş
episodes.description: Barışın yakında geleceğini düşünen Gennosuke ve Udono, Oboro ve Igas ile kutlama yapar. Ancak Iga klanı, bayram sırasında Gennosuke ve Udono'ya suikast düzenlemeyi planlıyor.

episodes.name: Sürpriz Saldırı
episodes.description: Kouga klanı, Tsubagakure'de Gennosuke ile ilgilendiklerini, hatta barış anlaşması hakkında bilgilendirildiklerini bile belirtti. Klanlar arasında çıkan savaştan haberdar değillerdi. Saemon, küçük kız kardeşi Okoi'yi Gennosuke'yi bulması için göndermeye karar verir.

episodes.name: Yağmurda Özlem
episodes.description: Şimdi Sunpu'da çok ciddi bir şey olması gerektiğini bilen Kougalar, barış gelirse Igas'ın köylerine saldırmayacağını bilerek araştırmaya karar verirler. Ancak, İgalar eve döndüklerinde, listelenen Kouga Ten'lerden biri olan Okoi'yi görürler ve onu esir tutmaya karar verirler.

episodes.name: kan emici baştan çıkarıcı kadın
episodes.description: Rousai, hayatta kalan Kougas'ın dövüş yeteneklerini öğrenmesi için Okoi'yi rahatsız ederken Koshiro, Oboro'ya Tenzen ile buluşması gerektiğini söylemek için gönderilir. Ancak Saemon, Yashamaru kılığında Tsubagakure'ye girmeyi başardığında, gördüğü şey hayatındaki en korkunç şey olacaktır.

episodes.name: Cage of Blood
episodes.description: With Tousai dead and lord Teyasu's ninja scroll lost to the Iga, the plan to rip the Kouga apart unnoticed is slowly falling apart. With her dying words, Okoi tells Saemon the registry's true location. Determined to make it out alive, Saemon will hold up his ruse long enough to walk out with the scroll in his hands and take vengeance for his sister's death along the way.

episodes.name: Farewell
episodes.description: With the scroll now in Gennosuke's possession, he makes the decision to either engage in war or not. However, with being attacked by Koshiro and the other deadly ninjas, Gennosuke may have a hard time getting out of the village.

episodes.name: Divine Mandate
episodes.description: Two woman who hate each other and a little boy could possibly be linked to why the Iga and Kouga hate each other this moment..

episodes.name: On Their Own
episodes.description: Gennosuke returns the scroll to the Iga and issues a challenge that if they attack the Kouga village they will annihilated. The people left can travel to Sunpu and join them. Tenzen accepts the challenge

episodes.name: Remembrance
episodes.description: After blinding Gennosuke, Saemon chases after Hotarubi who misleads him by making him follow her butterflies. A battle disrupts between the two.

episodes.name: A Swarm of Butterflies
episodes.description: Saemon, now having the appearance of Nenki, begins to confront Hotarubi. As the Kouga ready themselves to continue on to Sunpu, Tenzen knowing they can not wait for Nenki and Harutobi, leads the Igas across the ocean in hopes of stopping Gennosuke before he reaches his destination.

episodes.name: Fallen Flower
episodes.description: As the rest of the Igas cross the sea, Tenzen makes an advance towards Oboro, leaving Koshiro torn between his master and the clan leader. With all the confusion this makes for the perfect opportunity for an enemy to make his move.

episodes.name: Reckoning
episodes.description: Still on the sea, Gyobu uses his art to move around freely to take care of the remaining Iga, but Tenzen proves to be a toilsome foe to kill.

episodes.name: First Impressions
episodes.description: At a lighter time before the disintegration of the no-hostlities pact, talk of an arranged marriage stirred the clans, but could one marry a spouse that they have known to be their enemy?

episodes.name: Wandering Hearts
episodes.description: As the Kogas continue their journey to Sunpu, Oboro's hawk flies by carrying a scroll. While two ninjas pursue the hawk, Tenzen makes his move only to find something he did not expect.

episodes.name: A Dawn Without Light
episodes.description: As Hyoma and Koshiro battle, it is revealed that Hyoma was Gennosuke's mentor teaching him how to use his ability.

episodes.name: Conspiracy
episodes.description: Oboro and Akeginu discovers the lifeless bodies of Hyoma and Koshiro. Thinking that Koshiro was killed by Hyoma, Akeginu repeatedly stabs the already dead body of Hyoma.

episodes.name: River of Mercy
episodes.description: Akeginu vows revenge on Kagero after Tenzen reveals that Koshiro was killed by Kagero's breath.

episodes.name: With All Her Heart
episodes.description: Kagero sets out to kill Oboro, after telling Gennosuke that she killed her wanting gratitude. She however gets caught in a trap caused by Tenzen.

episodes.name: The Haunted
episodes.description: Oboro issues out a challenge to draw Gennosuke out from hiding. Meanwhile, with Kagero captive Tenzen tortures her with needles. Gennosuke finally arrives.

episodes.name: Emancipation
episodes.description: With Tenzen defeated, Gennosuke carries Kagero away. However wanting to be with him she tries to kill him with her poisonous breath. Oboro's eyes are finally open.

episodes.name: Requiem
episodes.description: The last battle between the Kouga and Iga, determining who will inherit the title of Shogun. Oboro and Gennosuke face each other for the last time.

episodes.name: Kiraz Çiçekleri Düştü
episodes.description: Kouga ve Iga ninja klanlarının yok edilmesinden on yıl sonra, gizli bir köyde sadece iki kişi hayatta kalır. Ama ninjaların kaderi henüz bitmedi...

episodes.name: Beş Hazine Geldi
episodes.description: Hachirou, ninja köyünden ayrılmak ve yeni bir hayata başlamak istiyor. O ve Hibiki asla birlikte olmayacaklar ve güçlerinden çok korkuyor. Ama Kouga ve Iga arasındaki savaş henüz bitmemiş olabilir...

episodes.name: Kouga Ölmeli
episodes.description: Gizemli bir ninja tarafından saldırıya uğrayan Beş Hazine'ye karanlık bir güç iner... yoksa o bir ninja mı?

episodes.name: Joujinshuu Görünüyor
episodes.description: Joujinshuu, Beş Çiçek'ten bir parça keserken, Iga ve Kouga'nın katliamı devam ediyor. Onlar kim ve ne istiyorlar?

episodes.name: Kiraz Çiçekleri Deli Koşuyor
episodes.description: Joujinshuu, ninjanın içinden bir parça kesmeye devam ediyor ve Hachirou'nun kendisi de savaşa katılmak zorunda kalıyor.

episodes.name: Şeytani Bulutlar Karışmaya Başlıyor
episodes.description: Uzun yıllar geçti. Hayatta kalan ninjalar saklanıyor ve Hachirou ortadan kayboldu. Joujinshuu henüz geri dönmedi, ancak bu göreceli barış günleri sonsuza kadar sürebilir mi?

episodes.name: Tadanaga's Change of Heart
episodes.description: As the black castle towers in the forest near the tea stand, Hachirou is called to meet Tadanaga, where he learns the truth about Tadanaga's thoughts during the incident four years ago.

episodes.name: The Advent of Joujin
episodes.description: The ninjas prepare to storm Murakumo as Hachirou escapes from Suruga's carefully-laid traps.

episodes.name: The Butterfly Dances
episodes.description: Hachirou is determined to slay Joujin and his Joujinshuu, but Joujin has deeper plans for the Lord of Suruga than he'd thought.

episodes.name: The Heavenly Robe Sees Carnage
episodes.description: The local daimyo stages an attack on the Joujinshuu's Murakumo castle. As their massive army is annihilated by the Murakumo's cannons, Tenkai realizes only ninjas can destroy the castle...

episodes.name: Like a Rhinoceros
episodes.description: As the ninjas prepare for an assault on the castle, Shikibu's armor breaks. Gorone attempts to repair it, but he's vulnerable when he's not wearing it. Then an enemy attacks, and separates him from the group...

episodes.name: Rüzgar Çamların Arasından Esiyor
episodes.description: Murakumo kalesine saldırı başladı ve ilk görev kaleyi çevreleyen birlikleri geri çekmek. Rui ve Shichigen bir saldırı girişiminde bulunur, ancak düşman teknikleri için hazırlanmıştır...

episodes.name: Utsutsu Cehennem Düşleri
episodes.description: Utsutsu'nun korkunç geçmişi ve tekniklerinin kaynağı ortaya çıkarken Murakumo'ya yapılan saldırı devam ediyor.

episodes.name: Murakamo Must Be Destroyed
episodes.description: Hadaebou infiltrates Murakumo castle, where he attempts to kill the Lord of Suruga. Joujin tries to get Hachirou and Hibiki to join forces with him.

episodes.name: The Shielding Eye Is Deceived
episodes.description: The Murakumo castle has vanished without a trace, and it seems as if the Joujinshuu have disappeared. The ninjas return to their normal lives, but is everything really over?

episodes.name: The Massive Castle Rumbles
episodes.description: Murakumo is back! Now the castle is on wheels and it's slowly heading towards Edo. The ninjas try to break in as Hachirou attempts to flee.

episodes.name: Everyone Gathers at the Battlefield
episodes.description: Tenkai's servant infiltrates Murakumo Castle with a mission: to bring Tadanaga back or to kill him if he refuses to leave.

episodes.name: The Cherry Blossoms Must Fall
episodes.description: Hadaebou's attempt to retrieve Tadanaga from Mukakumo Castle does not go as planned. Hachirou appears before the gathered ninjas of Kouga and Iga, faced with an enemy he cannot defeat alone.

episodes.name: 100 Eyes See Their Destiny
episodes.description: Hachirou enters the castle at last, as Saizou falls victim to Yasha Itaru's Destiny's Passage.

episodes.name: We Must See the Lotus Flowers Together
episodes.description: Saizou is dead, but his sacrifice has allowed the ninjas to proceed into Murakumo at last. But even greater threats await them inside.

episodes.name: Remembrance Must Fade
episodes.description: The ninjas make their way up Murakumo castle, but they're stopped by Neirichiou. He's still alive, and he wants them dead.

episodes.name: The Demon Revives
episodes.description: Kujaku's secret is revealed as Joujin meets a grisly end, and the Demon King Nobunaga revives.

episodes.name: The Cherry Blossoms Scatter
episodes.description: Nobunaga revives, only to quickly die again. Then Hibiki and Hachirou are trapped in a bizarre space created by the Joujinshuu's techniques. When they escape, they find themselves in a parallel world.

episodes.name: The Cherry Blossoms Bloom
episodes.description: In a parallel world, Hibiki and Hachirou face off with the Joujinshuu one final time. The Joujinshuu are caught off guard and overwhelmed, but Joujin still has a final trick up his sleeve: a deep connection to a powerful, hidden ninja.
